rv.q: If the play skims the surface of Shepherd's appeal as a writer, it is nonetheless a warm-hearted evocation of a life led with self-determination in and out of the shadows.
This play is living proof of the soul and indescribable patriotism and pride that Scottish art holds within itself and shares with its consumers.
The result over the play's seventy-five minutes is a love letter to Shepherd that can only help her work to be discovered in pastures new.
